answers.why: Elijah invokes the LORD as the God of the nation Israel before Ahab.
The LORD is called the God of Israel, identifying the nation's God.
Ahab accuses Elijah of troubling the nation Israel.
Elijah says Ahab and his father's house have troubled Israel by forsaking the LORD's commandments.
Elijah commands Ahab to gather all Israel at Mount Carmel.
The verse recalls God telling Jacob personally that Israel would be his name.
Israel is named alongside Abraham and Isaac as one of the patriarchs.
Elijah asks that the LORD be recognized as God in Israel by the assembled people.
Jehu is to be anointed king over the kingdom of Israel.
God preserves seven thousand people in Israel who have not worshipped Baal.
Israel's army pursues the fleeing Syrians.
Benhadad gathers the Syrian army to fight against Israel.
The kings of the house of Israel are rulers of the nation described as merciful.
